messages:
Sasha (incidents lead): Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for yesterday's outage. Need to lock down: statuspage language, 72h customer summary cadence, and the RCA sharing/consent process. Who can drive?
incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-03-22 (assigned: unclaimed) :spiral_calendar: 
Mike Ops: I can own statuspage copy and timeline. Proposal: immediate statuspage notice (root cause + mitigation), a 72h customer-facing summary with redacted details, and a full RCA shared 7 days after incident unless customer requests earlier. Thoughts? :+1:
Olivia Support: Support will handle outreach for impacted customers. We had asks last time for more redaction — need a clear consent flow and a short template we can paste into Intercom.
Jamie Product: Noting recurring pattern: cache warmup + rollout combo. Can we include a short "impact" sentence on statuspage plus an ETA for full RCA? Also suggest adding a recurring postmortem checklist item for rollout verification.
Priya Legal: High level: default = public summary (redacted). Full technical RCA = available on request under a consent/NDA flow. We must explicitly redact PII and customer-specific secrets. I'll draft a consent matrix; avoid sharing stack traces that contain tokens.
Sasha (incidents lead): Good. Let's capture action items and owners here. Also want a short, consistent statuspage phrasing so product/support don't craft divergent messages.
Mike Ops: Draft statuspage copy (WIP):
```
We experienced increased latencies for service X due to cache warmup after a rollout. Mitigation: rollback and throttling applied. Customers may see transient errors between 11:12–11:45 UTC. A 72-hour customer summary will be posted by <owner>. A full RCA will be available on request after redaction/consent.
```
Olivia Support: That draft looks good — please include a one-line "what we did to protect customers" snippet so ops/support can point to it in replies. Example: "We throttled incoming traffic and rolled back the release to restore normal service."
Priya Legal: Add: "No PII will be disclosed. For additional technical details we will coordinate a secured share under our standard process." I'll attach the consent matrix tomorrow.
Sasha (incidents lead): Action items (from thread) — please ack and add ETA: 
- mike_ops: finalize statuspage copy + publish 72h placeholder (due 2154432300)
- olivia_support: draft Intercom/coordinated customer outreach + template (due 2154432360)
- priya_legal: consent/redaction matrix + short policy blurb (due 2154432460)
- jamie_product: add rollout verification check to postmortem checklist and propose rollout guard (due 2154432600)
Please reply with ":thumbsup:" when you own it.
Mike Ops: :thumbsup: I'll take statuspage + 72h placeholder. Will publish and ping here when live.
Olivia Support: :thumbsup: I'll post outreach template here in the next 3 hours and coordinate DMs for high-touch customers.
Priya Legal: :thumbsup: I'll post the consent matrix and one-paragraph policy by EOD.
Jamie Product: :thumbsup: Adding checklist item and an initial rollout guard suggestion to the postmortem doc.
Sasha (incidents lead): Thanks team. Small ask: can Console/Docs add a simple flag on the incident metadata called "customer_facing_rca_ready: true/false" so we can track readiness and prevent premature full-RCA links being sent?
Mike Ops: I'll follow up with Console team after publishing the statuspage. If someone from Console sees this, please make it a tiny ticket.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up meeting in 48h to verify actions and customer comms.
Olivia Support: One more note — please include a short FAQ line on statuspage for customers asking how to request the full RCA (contact support + consent matrix link).
Sasha (incidents lead): Agreed. We'll reconvene in 48h. Thanks all.
